LockBit ransomware affiliates claimed responsibility for the breach at Acme Manufacturing
on May 10, 2026. The group listed the victim on their leak site and demanded 2.4 BTC
payment to wallet bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh.

Indicators of compromise observed during this campaign:
- C2 domain: bad-cdn.example[.]net
- Beacon IP: 198.51.100.42
- Dropper SHA256: 6e2c8b3f5a1d4f9e7c0b2a3d5e6f7891a4b5c6d7e8f90123456789abcdef0123
- Exploited vulnerability: CVE-2024-12345 (Acme Edge Gateway RCE)
- ATT&CK techniques observed: T1486 (Data Encrypted for Impact), T1490 (Inhibit System Recovery), T1059.001 (PowerShell)

The activity has been attributed to LockBit 3.0. The ransomware was deployed after exploiting
the Acme Edge Gateway flaw. A proof of concept was released on GitHub last week.

This activity targets the US defense industrial base and aerospace contractors.
